import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# Load the dataset from the provided string
csv_data = """survived,pclass,sex,age,sibsp,parch,fare,embarked,class,who,adult_male,deck,embark_town,alive,alone
0,3,male,22.0,1,0,7.25,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,False
1,1,female,38.0,1,0,71.2833,C,First,woman,False,C,Cherbourg,yes,False
1,3,female,26.0,0,0,7.925,S,Third,woman,False,,Southampton,yes,True
1,1,female,35.0,1,0,53.1,S,First,woman,False,C,Southampton,yes,False
0,3,male,35.0,0,0,8.05,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,True
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# --- Create Visualization ---

# Set a visually appealing style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", context="talk")

# Create a 2x2 subplot grid
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 14))
fig.suptitle('Key Factors in Titanic Survival', fontsize=24, weight='bold')

# --- Plot 1: Survival Rate by Passenger Class ---
ax1 = sns.barplot(
    data=df, x='class', y='survived', ax=axes[0, 0],
    palette='Blues_d', order=['First', 'Second', 'Third'], errorbar=None
)
ax1.set_title('Wealthier Passengers Had Higher Survival Rates', fontsize=16)
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=14)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=14)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1.1)
# Add percentage labels
for p in ax1.patches:
    if p.get_height() > 0:
        ax1.annotate(f'{p.get_height():.0%}',
                       (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                       ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=14, color='black', xytext=(0, 5),
                       textcoords='offset points')

# --- Plot 2: Survival Rate by Sex ---
ax2 = sns.barplot(
    data=df, x='sex', y='survived', ax=axes[0, 1],
    palette='Reds_d', errorbar=None
)
ax2.set_title('Women Were Far More Likely to Survive', fontsize=16)
ax2.set_xlabel('Sex', fontsize=14)
ax2.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=14)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 1.1)
# Add percentage labels
for p in ax2.patches:
    if p.get_height() > 0:
        ax2.annotate(f'{p.get_height():.0%}',
                       (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                       ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=14, color='black', xytext=(0, 5),
                       textcoords='offset points')

# --- Plot 3: Age Distribution of Survivors vs. Non-Survivors ---
ax3 = sns.kdeplot(
    data=df, x='age', hue='alive', ax=axes[1, 0],
    fill=True, common_norm=False, palette='Greens_d', alpha=0.6, linewidth=2
)
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=16)
ax3.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=14)
ax3.set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=14)
ax3.legend(title='Survived', labels=['Yes', 'No'])

# --- Plot 4: Survival by Embarkation Port ---
ax4 = sns.countplot(
    data=df, x='embark_town', hue='alive', ax=axes[1, 1],
    palette='Purples_d', order=['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Queenstown']
)
ax4.set_title('Survival Counts by Port of Embarkation', fontsize=16)
ax4.set_xlabel('Port of Embarkation', fontsize=14)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=14)
ax4.legend(title='Survived')

# Adjust layout and save the file
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
